author: Osaid52

title: Such strange mistake!
body:
The app looks perfect, well designed, informative, it doesn’t spam you with advertisements and lets you manage both good and bad habits with very flexible tuning, but there are so strange mistake!
For some reason [only] bad habits don’t have a timer and pomodoro feature, you can’t say to the app “I am starting playing video games, stop me when it is enough for today”, you can just log info or say “succeeded”, it’s so stupid! The only difference between good and bad habits should be that good ones are limited from below and bad habits are limited from above!
And also I faced a lot of crashes while investigating the app: very often when you touch some habit, the app freezes until full app restart.

author: tal.mizz

title: Excellent app!
body:
Found this app through an online advertisement on one of my other apps. Didn't think such marketing world but decided to try it out. Did the free version for about a month and then decided to book a month of paid. This app is so motivational that eventually I decided to pay for the whole year! I'm currently having around 11 habits every day that I'm going through and I manage to do pretty much all of them most of the time! It's great for managing all my hobbies and things I want to get into and make sure I do them!
Been using this app for about 3 months now, and super happy with it! In fact it became now one of my most used apps on my phone, as I often check what I need to do each day and record the time it takes me, which I like to look at when I get reports each week.

If you have good habits or tasks you want to get into and do more often, this app is great for tracking them and motivating you to do them often (it keeps track of your streak, which you don't want to lose). Highly recommended!
